title: When to Hire an n8n Developer: Count Failure Modes, Not Workflows.
meta_description: n8n makes building easy on purpose, so the number of workflows tells you almost nothing about the cost. Hire for the run that fails, the retry that fires twice, and the execution that succeeded with the wrong arguments. Plus what n8n's own plans actually retain.
